# PROJECT: STANCHION
A neon-noir pixel art time-management arcade action game where you run a chaotic concession stand!

## How to Play
- Move your worker between 3 lanes using Arrow Keys
- Interact with stations (Grill, Fryer, Drink, Register) using Space
- Build orders by visiting stations in sequence: Grill → Build → Fryer → Drink → Register
- Serve customers before their patience runs out!
- Master the payment mini-game to earn tips and upgrades
- Survive 5 minutes per shift, avoid 3 strikes, and beat your high score!
